note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. Both scenes share the same placeholder decision, the same arrow and the same review frame over the supplied range (routes.from..routes.to). Exactly ONE fact differs: the section the question's arrow points at (A: grounds[a].section, B: grounds[b].section). 'Inside / outside the frame' only describes geometry of supplied data; there is no winner, score or outcome, and no rule about what a review may cover is drawn. A and B have equal weight (same size, ink, timing). Brief fields: decisions, grounds, routes, outcomes, scenarioA, scenarioB, changedFact, sharedFacts and comparisonLabels are editable. Coordinator decision (standing rule 2026-09-26, from LAW-0687/0689–0692): after trying the 1:1 fallbacks (compact rows without index pips, narrower insets and gap, bars removed), six two-line section tags could not fit two side-by-side scenes at >= 16 px, so the long-labels-stress section tags are capped at 35 characters ('Section N of the fictional decision'), still longer than the baseline tags (25); all other stress fields stay at near-maximum length. Measured DOM-less 2026-10-05: uncapped stress at 1:1 needs 845 design units of height at 16 px against 738 available.
